room:foire/on.foire.monter-wagon.do[0].s: Woof. It's closed. My ghosts are on strike.
Hands off, sweetie! Here, cotton candy has to be earned.
A salesman! At last! My old witch's back can't take any more.
Customers ask for a color, you serve the right one. Easy, sweetie.
Easy. I was born for this. Well, I died for this.
A little ghost would like a PINK cotton candy.
A witch wants the GREEN one. Like her nose.
A vampire asks for the BLUE one. "Not the red, I'm on a diet."
Cobweb cotton candy! The customer runs off screaming… then comes back: he forgot to pay.
Not that one! The customer makes a funny face.
You serve very well, sweetie. But the children are scared of your head. They shake while they eat.
Here's your pay: one cotton candy. And good luck out there!
Second time fired today. I'm getting better at it.
No, sweetie. The children are still shaking. Look, that one's making ice cubes.
Retired. Now I make sugar. It's sticky magic.
room:foire/talk.carrousel.foire.carrouse: My carousel is broken! Pépite, my little dragon, is scared of children. He won't go round anymore.
A scared dragon? I know a bit about that. From the other side.
If you calm him down, the tamer job is yours. You have to pet him, very gently.
A kid told him he looked like a lizard. He never got over it.
I've got my Job Fright Center paperwork!
Job Fright Center paperwork! All in order! Woof!
Right. You're hired on trial. Tonight is Halloween: if the train reopens and the customers come out happy…
…AND paying. Above all, paying. Then the job is yours.
And what's wrong in the train?
Everything. The ghosts are on strike, the power is out, and nobody knows we're reopening.
Get in the cart, the tunnel is behind it.
Everything's ready!
The ghosts are working, the train is running, there's a line. I can't believe it.
Time for the dress rehearsal. The first customers are coming! Go hide in the train!
How are we doing?
The ghosts are back at work. Well done.
The ghosts are still on strike. Go see Ginette, in the train.
The power's back on.
Still no power. The fuse box is at the back of the tunnel.
The poster is a smash hit.
And nobody knows we're reopening. We need a scary poster on the billboard.
What's the job?
You hide in the dark, and when the cart goes by, BOO. But not too loud. They have to pay on the way out.
Are you hiring at the ghost train?
Woof. Sorry, my ghost train is closed. My ghosts are on strike.
I'm scary. Very scary. Too scary, even. Hire me!
You need Job Fright Center paperwork. It's the law. Come back with it, we'll see.
Why are your ghosts on strike?
They want new sheets. And lighter chains. I get it.
Are you a werewolf?
Only on full-moon nights. The rest of the time, I'm an accountant.

room:train/look.gloubi: Gloubi, in the cart. He takes up three seats.
room:train/on.train.look-fantomes-travai: Gaston, wrapped in new bandages. His bike chain makes a lovely clinking.
room:train/on.train.look-tableau-ok.do[0: The fuse box. Everything's plugged in. I'm an electrician now.
room:train/on.train.draps.do[2].say: Egyptian linen! Three kilometers! We can make sheets… and curtains.
room:train/on.train.draps.do[3]: The ghosts wrap themselves up in it. They look like mummies. They love it.
Comrades, our demands have been met. Back to work!
Thanks, pumpkin. You're a good colleague. For someone on trial.
room:train/on.train.chaines.do[3].say: A bike chain! So light! Just listen to that little clink…
room:train/on.train.chaines.do[4]: Gaston jingles it. Bouh starts pedaling in thin air.
room:train/on.train.chaines.do[5].then[0: Comrades, our demands have been met. Back to work!
room:train/on.train.chaines.do[5].then[4: Thanks, pumpkin. You're a good colleague. For someone on trial.
room:train/on.train.chaussette-ginette.d: A sock? We don't have feet. But it's the thought that counts.
room:train/on.train.tableau-ok.do[0]: Everything works. I'm not touching anything else.
room:train/on.train.tableau.do[0]: The fuse box. Looks like a plate of spaghetti.
room:train/on.train.tableau.do[2].params: Follow each wire through the tangle, Jack, and plug it into the socket of its color.
The ghost train ran into a problem and needs to haunt again. Boo.
room:train/on.train.tableau.do[2].then[3: The lamps come on, the organ starts up, the eyes in the paintings light up.
room:train/on.train.tableau.do[2].then[4: It works! I'm an electrician now. That's two jobs in one evening.
room:train/on.train.prendre-cercueil.do[: Empty. The tenant's on vacation. He left a note: "Boo."
room:train/on.train.prendre-lustre.do[0]: If I pull on it, it'll fall on my pumpkin. No thanks.
room:train/talk.ginette.train.ginette.gr: Clean sheets, not dirty rags! Light chains, not ball-and-chains!
Hello. I'm the new guy. On trial.
A scab! Er, a pumpkin. A pumpkin-headed strikebreaker!
No, no. I'm on your side. What do you need?
New sheets, ours have holes. And light chains: we've got bruised ankles.
Until we get both, we haunt nobody. Solidarity!
room:train/talk.ginette.train.ginette.po: Three hundred years haunting in holey sheets, with convict chains. Enough is enough!
room:train/talk.ginette.train.ginette.qu: Gaston does the chain noises. And little Bouh is an intern. He only says "boo".
I see. It's all in the nuance.
room:train/hints[0].lines[0]: Ginette is leading the strike. Talk to her.
room:train/hints[1].lines[0]: New sheets: Mrs. Bandage, on the square, surely has spare bandages.
room:train/hints[2].lines[0]: GIVE the roll of bandages to Ginette.
room:train/hints[3].lines[0]: Light chains: the bike Gloubi spat out on the square has a chain.
room:train/hints[4].lines[0]: GIVE the bike chain to Ginette.
room:train/hints[5].lines[0]: The fuse box, at the back. USE it.
room:train/hints[6].lines[0]: The poster's still missing, outside, on the billboard in front of the train.
room:train/onEnter[0].once[0]: It's dark as the inside of a pumpkin. Luckily, my head lights up.
room:train/onEnter[1].then[0].cutscene[0: The cart rolls in. Sergeant Headless, the Mayor and Gloubi. Quick, a hiding place!
room:train/onEnter[1].then[0].cutscene[1: Hide well, Jack. And pop out in the right place. Not too loud!
room:train/onEnter[1].then[1].params.int: Where should you hide to pop out at the right moment?
room:train/onEnter[1].then[1].params.spo: Jack hangs from the chandelier… which comes loose. Bouh says "boo". Nobody's scared.
The wardrobe is already taken: Gaston keeps his chains in it.
Jack pops out of the barrel too early. Gloubi thinks he's the appetizer.
room:train/onEnter[1].then[1].then[1].sa: AAAH! At last, I see scary things! It's wonderful!
room:train/onEnter[1].then[1].then[2].sa: My bolts are shaking! I vote yes! I vote twice!
room:train/onEnter[1].then[1].then[3].sa: Gloubi got scared! Gloubi didn't even swallow the cart! Again!
room:train/onEnter[1].then[1].then[4]: They come out laughing… and they pay. All three of them. Twice.
item:mireille/look[0]: Mireille, my pet spider. She lives in my head.
item:mireille/look[1]: She's knitting. In my head. It tickles.
item:mireille/look[2]: If I'm lost, I talk to her.
item:mireille/look[3]: She waves at me with six legs out of eight.
item:lanterne/look[0]: My lantern. It glows. Like my head, but smaller.
item:lanterne/look[1]: A lantern looking for a head.
item:badge/look[0]: "Employee of the Month". All twelve months. I was the only employee.
item:chaussette/look[0]: A green sock, all slimy. It isn't mine.
item:barbe/look[0]: A pink cotton candy. My pay. I won't eat it, I don't have a stomach.
item:barbe/look[1]: Someone on the square dreams of it.
item:boulon/look[0]: A neck bolt. Still warm. Yuck.
item:nez/look[1]: With this, I'll have a party face.
item:photo_ratee/look[0]: My photo. Even I'm a little scared.
item:photo_ratee/look[1]: The photographer was a machine. It quit.
item:photo/look[0]: I look like an accountant who loves balloons. Perfect.
item:lettre/look[0]: "Jack is honest, hard-working, and he returned a bolt." Signed: the Mayor.
item:fiche_poste/look[0]: "Ghost train seeks scary employee. Trial period: Halloween night." At Mr. Wolfgang's.
item:fiche_poste/look[1]: Scary, I can do. Employee, I'm learning.
item:bandelettes/look[0]: Three kilometers of Egyptian linen. A gift from Mrs. Bandage.
item:bandelettes/look[1]: It smells a bit like a pyramid.
item:chaine/look[0]: The chain from the bike Gloubi spat out. Light, and still a bit slimy.
item:chaine/look[1]: It makes a lovely little clink.
char:hero/hug: A bony hug. Mind the ribs.
char:radinoff/refuse: A gift? Is it free? No. Suspicious.
char:radinoff/hug: A hug? That'll be two euros.
char:bandelette/refuse: That's not on the liiist of required documents.
char:maire/refuse: I don't accept gifts. Only votes.
char:maire/hug: A handshake, rather. If it holds.
char:gloubi/refuse: Gloubi not hungry for that. Gloubi wants cotton candy.
char:brigadier/refuse: A bribe? I saw nothing. Naturally.
char:guimauve/hug: Come here, sweetie! You smell of pumpkin.
char:carrousel/refuse: Thanks, but my hands are full. Of worries.
char:ginette/refuse: That's not one of our demands, comrade.
char:ginette/hug: A solidarity hug! Careful, I'm a bit see-through.
rules/fallbacks.give[1]: I'll keep it. You never know.
rules/fallbacks.look[1]: It looks like what it is.
rules/fallbacks.talk[1]: It doesn't talk. Maybe it listens.
rules/kinds[0].say: I can't carry {name}. I'm a skeleton, not a crane.
rules/kinds[1].say: We don't push people around. Not even for a job.
rules/kinds[2].say: Pull {name}? A piece might come off.
start/intro[0].cutscene.game.intro.l1.sa: Jack, my boy. Sit down. Ah, no, not on the chair, it's new.
start/intro[0].cutscene.game.intro.l2.sa: Yesterday, you scared a whole busload of tourists.
start/intro[0].cutscene.game.intro.l4.sa: They ran off. WITHOUT PAYING. You're fired.
start/intro[0].cutscene.game.intro.l6.sa: Clear out your locker. And give back the lantern, it belongs to the manor.
